https://dspace.cuni.cz/bitstream/handle/20.500.11956/177254/120370266.pdf?sequence=1&isAllowed=y .

technologiques-quantiques-et-lancement-du-programme-proqcima. 
Furukawa, Yuki. “Japan Tightens Export Controls on More Chip and Quantum Tech.” Bloomberg, April 26, 
2024. https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-04-26/japan-tightens-export-controls-on-more-chip-and-quantum-
tech.

innovations/trusted-ict/quantum-computers-cancer-detection.

https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/mckinsey-digital/our-insights/how-quantum-computing-can-help-tackle-global-
warming 
Gambetta, Jay. “The Hardware and Software for the Era of Quantum Utility is Here.” IBM Quantum Research, December 4, 
2023. https://www.ibm.com/quantum/blog/quantum-roadmap-2033. 
“Government Bans on Quantum Computer Exports Have No Basis in Science.” New Scientist, July 10, 2024. 
https://www.newscientist.com/article/mg26334993-100-governments-bans-on-quantum-computer-exports-have-no-basis-
in-science. 
Haeck, Pieter. “Europe is Ring-Fencing the Next Critical Tech: Quantum.” Politico, February 27, 2024. 
https://www.politico.eu/article/how-europe-ring-fencing-quantum-computing-technology-defense. 
Hamlin, James and Brian Zhou. “Extreme Diamond-Based Quantum Sensors.” Science 366 (2019): 1312–1313. 
https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aaz4982.  
Harford, James. Reconsidering Sputnik. London: Routledge, 2000. 
Hrynkiv, “Legal and Policy Responses to National Security Measures in International Economic Law.” Georgetown Journal 
of International Law 54, no 2 (2023). https://www.law.georgetown.edu/international-law-journal/in-print/volume-
54/volume-54-number-2-winter-2023/legal-and-policy-responses-to-national-security-measures-in-international-
economic-law. 
Hrynkiv, Olga and Saskia Lavrijssen. “Not Trading with the Enemy: The Case of Computer Chips.” Journal of World Trade 
58, no 1 (2024): 61–86. https://doi.org/10.54648/trad2024003.  
IBM Scientists Cool Down the World’s Largest Quantum-Ready Cryogenic Concept System.” IBM Quantum Research Blog. 
https://www.ibm.com/quantum/blog/goldeneye-cryogenic-concept-system. 
Jarrahi, Mohammad Hossein and Steve Sawyer. “Networks of Innovation: The Sociotechnical Assemblage of Tabletop 
Computing.” Research Policy 48 (2019). https://doi.org/10.1016/j.repolx.2018.100001. 
Jasanoff, Sheila, and Sang-Hyun Kim (eds). Dreamscapes of Modernity: Sociotechnical Imaginaries and the Fabrication of 
Power. Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 2015. 
Kim, Youngseok et al. “Evidence for the Utility of Quantum Computing Before Fault Tolerance.” Nature 618 (2023): 500–
505. https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-023-06096-3. 
Krelina, Michal. “Quantum Technology for Military Applications”. EPJ Quantum Technology 8: art 24 (2021). 
https://doi.org/10.1140/epjqt/s40507-021-00113-y. 
Krige, John and Mario Daniels. “Change and Continuity in US Export Control Policy.” Issues in Science and Technology 39, 
no 2 (2023): 24–26. https://issues.org/us-export-control-policy-krige-daniels.
